app_fee.value: Application fee is $155 for international applicants ($135 for domestic applicants).
app_fee.quote: The application fee is $135 for domestic applicants and $155 for international applicants.

fee_waiver.value: Fee waivers are only for U.S. citizens and permanent residents, based on program participation or financial need.
fee_waiver.quote: Graduate application fee waivers are available for eligible U.S. citizens or permanent residents based on program participation or demonstrated financial need.

gre_general.value: Each program sets its own GRE rule (optional, not required, or not considered); the university-wide rule could not be fetched.

toefl_min.value: Applicants whose schooling was mainly not in English must send TOEFL or IELTS scores, but no fetched page gives a minimum score; the requirements page with the score table returned 403.
toefl_min.quote: Provide TOEFL or IELTS test scores (international students only).

ielts_min.value: No fetched page gives an overall IELTS band; the requirements page with the score table returned 403.
ielts_min.quote: Provide TOEFL or IELTS test scores (international students only).

english_waiver.value: The fetched flyers require a test for applicants whose schooling was not mainly in English, but name no exemption list and do not mention India or English-medium degrees.
english_waiver.quote: All graduate applicants, regardless of citizenship, whose preparatory education was principally in a language other than English, must show evidence of having taken the Test of English as a Foreign Language

notes: Sources are Graduate Division program flyers on uc-merced.foleon.com (fee, fee waiver, TOEFL/IELTS, degree requirements). Blocked (403/502): graduatedivision.ucmerced.edu pages (FAQ, application dates, international applicants, requirements, node/30, node/27391), iss.ucmerced.edu/English, the catalog (catalog.ucmerced.edu, 502), the 2020-21 and 2023-24 Graduate Policies handbooks, and physics.ucmerced.edu. Unfetched search snippets, not saved as values: TOEFL iBT 80 and IELTS 6.5 on the requirements page; a Duolingo option; the India-related exemption wording. The CBC and Physics research-area pages say 'Application fee waivers are available in cases of financial need, upon request' without a citizenship limit; the applying pages restrict waivers to U.S. citizens and permanent residents, so fee_waiver follows the applying pages.
